title: FreeCalcHub Metrics Snapshot
description: Point-in-time capture of SEO/performance metrics for freecalchub.com. Used either standalone (files in tracking/baselines/ or tracking/snapshots/) or embedded inside a mission's data.json under the metrics_snapshot property (see templates/deliverables/aimpactscanner-data.schema.json). Fields representing measurements not yet collected MAY be null; the captured boolean inside each collection block signals collection status. Schema is intentionally permissive for human-edited TODO baselines.

schema_version.description: Locked while tracking infrastructure is still emerging. Bump via documented migration once a track.py compare tool depends on a stable shape.

schema_note.description: Free-form note about schema version status or known gaps.

baseline_id.description: Stable identifier. Convention: <YYYY-MM-DD>-<kebab-label>. Required by convention (not by schema) when this snapshot is intended to be referenced by later snapshots.

commit_sha.description: Repo commit SHA at capture time. Lets you reproduce the codebase state.

deploy_status.description: Distinguishes local repo state from live-website state. Critical because tag-coverage figures from the local repo may NOT match what live freecalchub.com is serving.

scope.description: Whole domain, specific path prefix, single page URL, or freeform description.

compare_due.description: When the matching post-snapshot should be captured. Either an ISO date or a freeform expression like 'deploy_date + 28 days (tbd)'.

tag_coverage_post_fix_local.description: Coverage as observed in the local repo at this commit. Use when the snapshot bookends a fix that has been committed but not yet deployed.

tag_coverage_pre_fix.description: Coverage before the fix work began. Preserved for diff convenience.

tag_coverage_live.description: Coverage as observed on the live website at capture time. Use for post-deploy snapshots (where it will diverge from any local state in the repo).

scorecards_post_fix_local.description: Scorecard totals for the local commit being captured.

scorecards_pre_fix.description: Scorecard totals before the fix work began.

live_metrics_pending_manual_capture.description: Container for live-web measurements that need human action to populate. Each child block exposes a captured boolean to mark completion plus an instructions string explaining how.

filters.description: Optional generalisation: arbitrary named filter slices.

deploy.description: Optional. Information about the deployment this snapshot brackets.

related_runs.description: Mission run directories that this snapshot relates to.

source.description: How the counts were measured (grep command, commit, scope, etc.).

inp_ms.description: Interaction to Next Paint in milliseconds.

cls.description: Cumulative Layout Shift (unitless, lower is better).
